title: Reading Drill — Checking the Park's Opening Hours
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Checking the Park's Opening Hours
passages.body:
**A** A volunteer group compared three possible times to open a small park. Members collected information about early users by leaving a survey card at nearby cafés, since the park gates were still closed when those users walked past.

**B** The opening time was brought forward on weekdays only. At the same time, the caretaker changed the start time of his inspection to ensure that he could check paths before users arrived.

**C** Later, a school asked for occasional earlier access at weekends. The caretaker refused to issue permanent keys but offered to unlock the side gate for booked visits during the trial.
